text.description_html:
Door Wheel for LCN 4111T Door Closer, LCN-4110T-3034

This is the New Style replacement wheel for LCN 4111T (LCN Super Smoothee) Track Door Closer. NOT for use with hold open. For Hold Open closers use LCN 4110T-3034H

Also available other LCN Door Closer Parts

Quiet, low friction roller assembly. Nylon wheel assembly with internal roller bearing and thrush bearing.

*Sold Individually
